items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: like John Hammond put some money behind Basie.

ctx.x: Why did they all want to do it?

Well, they come there because they're gettin' a stamp on themselves. Yeah, if they get the stamp on them, maybe that would make them...maybe they'd (?) everything and they'd have to bring(?) the dates out there, and they might get a break with some of those big agents to put some money behind them, so they might go on the road with a big band or something or another. All the nice bands. You can count 'em on one hand that were lucky enough where somebody, some big rich man put some money behind them, like John…
